schema_subset: AI-CAD structural subset of JSON Schema 2020-12; integer is an integer JSON token; numbers must be finite; identifier is ASCII alphanumeric or ._:-

path.description: Local native .smb output path; parent must exist; no NUL

access_commands.description: Render a versioned CAD scene as shaded, Face ID and Edge ID PNGs; images are base64. Optional directory also saves PNG files.
Pick a visible edge or face in a cached frame; reject stale revisions. Null reference means background or ambiguity.
Refresh authoritative document states and event cursor in the attached session.
Pull committed changes after cursor; resync_required means fetch a new snapshot.
Create an isolated session using an idempotency key.
Attach this frontend to an existing session.
Reconnect to the same service/worker after an uncertain result. Never replays a command.
Query the cached outcome of an earlier request from this logical client.
Explicitly shut down the entire shared service; memory documents will be lost.
List recently published viewport frames in this session, including view identity and camera.
Capture the exact committed viewport frame by ID; reject changed geometry or superseded views.
